answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a vault as the anchor of the cost.
